hints.content:
The time when Sean drank all the slushy is the same as when the amount of slushy was $0$ milliliters. So we need to look for the point on the graph where **Slushy** is $0$, which is the $x$-intercept.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A first quadrant coordinate plane. The horizontal axis is from zero to eighty with a scale of five and is titled Time in seconds. The vertical axis is from zero to six hundred with a scale of fifty and is titled Slushy in milliliters. The graph of the line is y equals negative eight x plus six hundred. The graph ends at each axis. The point seventy-five zero is plotted.

hints.content: The $x$-intercept is $(75,0)$, which means that **Sean finished drinking all the slushy after $75$ seconds.**

question.content:
Sean is drinking a slushy as fast as he can.

The amount of slushy left in the cup (in milliliters) as a function of time (in seconds) is graphed.



[[☃ image 1]]

**How long did it take Sean to finish the slushy?**

[[☃ numeric-input 1]] seconds
